what_changed: FCC further delayed the effective date of the rule treating a consent revocation as applying to all robocalls and robotexts from the caller.
compliant_agent_must_now: Continue honoring revocations within 10 business days for the called purpose. Until 2027-04-11, revocation of one message type need not stop unrelated informational calls, if other law allows.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Does any state layer require broader opt-out handling that makes the delay moot?
rationale: Final rule on a tracked TCPA section. eCFR has no after-text yet (pending_effective). Abstract states the delay.
